title: Convex hypersurfaces and robust heterodimensional dynamics
summary: We prove that any closed orientable hypersurface in a contact manifold of dimension five or greater is isotopic to a robustly non-convex hypersurface via an arbitrarily $C^0$-small isotopy. This strengthens a recent result of the first author and yields a strong counterpart to the groundbreaking density theorem of Honda-Huang and Giroux. This is proven by combining a new convexity obstruction via heteroclinics and recent advances in robust heterodimensional dynamics due to Li-Turaev to produce a robust deconvexifying plug, which is a local and robust convexity obstruction.
